name: Alexander Stamps & Coin Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Alexander Stamps and Coin Ltd is in the business of philatelic and numismatic activity[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) ASCL is in the business of dealing in philatelic and numismatic activities through its brand named Alexander
b) The stamps possessed by the co. are rare collections and collected by various Philatelists. 
c) People can place order from the company's website to purchase these precious assets at predetermined prices fixed by the company from time to time.
d) The collection consists of rare antique pieces
e) Their Numismatics division has curated rare vintage coins and currency notes that have been long out of circulation from countries such as India, Mauritius, Malaya, Pakistan, etc.
